title: Ladder match body
description: One match of a ladder round (register row DK1741; spec-delta S1598): the pair, the score for the first (1000 a win, 500 a draw, 0 a loss) and the hash of the transcript, from which the result is recomputable. Signed by the operator as the referee. The log refuses a pairing that the season's draw does not give for the round (ladder_not_drawn): an agreed match is not recorded, so it cannot count. A match between agents of one controller, or beyond three between the same two controllers, is recorded and NOT counted (the table says why). Chain: none (prev is null).
